rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; the second takes line 1 as a single supplied amount, while the project computes it from the filer's traditional IRA contributions and the deduction worksheet, as the second's own note says the instructions allow.

Ruling: representation; the second takes line 2 as a single supplied total basis, while the project computes it from the filer's basis input (person.ira_basis) and its other IRA inputs; whether each adjustment the second names (excess returned, divorce transfers, rollovers of nontaxable amounts) is asked or refused is not settled by this comparison and is not a transcription difference.

Ruling: representation; the second makes the Part I question after line 3 a supplied answer; the project derives it from the distribution and conversion inputs it already asks (person.ira_dist and the rest).
